description: Sends a notice from the organizer of an event, or a host of a personal event, to the people who added the event pass to their Wallet ("doors open at 7 now"). It shows on their lock screen and stays on the pass. A notice with a place (`placeLabel`, coordinates, `at`) is a meetup. Two steps: without `confirm` it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it sends. Only the hosts or the organizer can send; anybody else is refused. "my_booth" returns VENDOR_OFF. Six an hour per event, then RATE_LIMITED. Needs a personal connector token.

at.description: Optional time, with a time zone.

audience.description: everyone, tier, intent, serials, booth, meetup_yes or meetup_no.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

relevantText.description: Optional line shown near the place.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id sends once.

text.description: One plain line, up to 120 characters.

name: event_pass_notice
title: Send a notice to a group of pass holders (hosts and organizers only)
